gate_scope: PASS applies only to completed measurement review, directly opened method citations and traceable deterministic math diagnostics. Financial replication and original-study numeric verification remain NOT_VERIFIED, not passed.
unresolved_blockers: Original study identity and original numeric evidence missing
Qualified historical article availability and scoring-vintage data missing
Target-specific market timing study not frozen or executed
Independent empirical replication and costed execution not performed
claims_authorized: Definition of mean/std/product and its algebraic limitations
Candidate design proposed with explicit missing-input status
claims_not_authorized: Screenshot IC numbers reproduced or independently verified
Product predicts market turning points or net strategy profit
publication_verification: Tracked separately in the subsequent step and sync receipt; not implied by this methodological audit
